extraction: per row: B365H/B365D/B365A closing odds; proportional de-vig p_draw = (1/B365D) / (1/B365H + 1/B365D + 1/B365A); realized = 1 if FTR == 'D' else 0. Rows skipped only if any B365 odd missing/unparseable.
known_bad_row_test: Take the manifest rows, flip exactly one row's FTR (D->H) or swap its de-vig method to power, recompute mean_assigned, realized, dcg_pp and paired_se_pp from the manifest; the rerun must produce different numbers and reject the manifest as inconsistent with the frozen fixture table.
